description: This file manages application settings for the Notesnook project, including initialization, resetting, migration, privacy screen handling, and lock mechanisms.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets specific settings related to reminders and backups.

methods.name: resetSettings
methods.description: Resets all settings to default values and reinitializes the app.

methods.name: migrateAppLock
methods.description: Handles migration of app lock settings based on previous configuration.

methods.name: migrateSettings
methods.description: Migrates settings to a new version if needed.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes settings, applies migrations, and sets up privacy screen.

methods.name: setPrivacyScreen
methods.description: Enables or disables privacy screen based on settings.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Updates settings with new values and persists them.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Gets a specific property from settings.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific property in settings.

methods.name: checkOrientation
methods.description: Placeholder for orientation check logic (commented out).

methods.name: canLockAppInBackground
methods.description: Checks if app can be locked when in background.

methods.name: appEnteredBackground
methods.description: Records timestamp when app enters background.

methods.name: getBackgroundEnterTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of when app entered background.

methods.name: shouldLockAppOnEnterForeground
methods.description: Determines if app should lock on foreground based on settings and background time.
